## Details

<a id="room_colour_fill"></a>
### [`room_colour_fill`](../../../../src/room/room_palettes_47a0.asm#L7) `$47A0-$47B3`

*data*

Colour RAM fill per room (20 bytes, index = room). draw_room fills colour RAM $D878-$DBFF (rows 3-24) with it before it draws the map. Low nibble = colour of the %11 multicolour pixels, bit 3 = multicolour on.

- **Read by:** [`draw_room`](draw_room.md#draw_room)

<a id="palette_backup"></a>
### [`palette_backup`](../../../../src/room/room_palettes_47a0.asm#L15) `$47B4-$47C7`

*variable*

Screen saver copy of the 20 band colours room_band_colours ($0153-$0166): start_screen_saver saves them, stop_screen_saver restores them, and while idle_timer is negative frame_update writes (copy EOR saver_eor_mask) AND saver_and_mask back to room_band_colours every frame (colour cycling). The image bytes are leftovers.

- **Read by:** [`stop_screen_saver`](../game/game_setup.md#stop_screen_saver), [`frame_update`](../game/frame_update.md#frame_update)
- **Written by:** [`start_screen_saver`](../game/game_setup.md#start_screen_saver)

<a id="room_palette_r0_3"></a>
### [`room_palette_r0_3`](../../../../src/room/room_palettes_47a0.asm#L23) `$47C8-$47D0`

*data*

Raster band palettes: 3-byte records (BGCOL0, BGCOL1, BGCOL2), one record per colour band, band 0 first. room_palette_ptr points each room at its first record; irq_game_bottom copies 12 bytes from there to room_band_colours every frame. A room uses 1 + (number of raster splits) records, so the copied bytes after them are not used.

- **Entry of:** [`room_palette_ptr`](../../tables.md#room_palette_ptr)

<a id="raster_split_lines"></a>
### [`raster_split_lines`](../../../../src/room/room_palettes_47a0.asm#L50) `$47F5-$47F8`

*variable*

Raster lines of the colour splits of the current room (4 bytes, ended by $FD), copied every frame by irq_game_bottom from the room's split list. irq_arm_next_split reads entry raster_split_index.

- **Read by:** [`irq_game_playfield`](../irq/game_irq.md#irq_game_playfield), [`irq_game_colour_split`](../irq/game_irq.md#irq_game_colour_split)
- **Written by:** [`irq_game_bottom`](../irq/game_irq.md#irq_game_bottom)

<a id="split_list_r0"></a>
### [`split_list_r0`](../../../../src/room/room_palettes_47a0.asm#L54) `$47F9-$47FB`

*data*

Raster split lists: raster lines where the next colour band starts (the colours change 3 lines later), ended by $FD. $FD is also the raster line of irq_game_bottom. split_list_none = no split.

- **Entry of:** [`room_split_list_ptr`](../../tables.md#room_split_list_ptr)
